question: What do you do with a book? 📖
explanation: Yay! We read books to learn new things! 📚
hint: You use your eyes to look at the words.

question: Which word is an action? 🏃‍♂️
explanation: Super star! Running is something you do with your legs! 👟
hint: It is something you can do at the park.

question: What do fish do in the water? 🐟
explanation: Awesome! Fish use their fins to swim in the water! 🌊
hint: They move through the water like you do in a pool.

question: What do birds do in the sky? 🐦
explanation: Great job! Birds use their wings to fly high! ☁️
hint: They move up in the air.

question: What do you do with a yummy apple? 🍎
explanation: Yay! We eat apples because they are tasty and healthy! 🍏
hint: You use your mouth and teeth.

question: What do you do with a glass of water? 💧
explanation: Fantastic! We drink water when we are thirsty! 💦
hint: You swallow it to feel fresh.

question: Which word is an action word? ⚽
explanation: Woohoo! Play is a fun action we do with our friends! 🎉
hint: It is what you do at recess.

question: What do you do with a pencil? ✏️
explanation: Super star! We use pencils to write letters and numbers! 📝
hint: You make marks on paper with it.

question: What do cute green frogs do? 🐸
explanation: Awesome! Frogs have strong legs to hop around! 🌿
hint: They jump up and down.

question: What do you do when you hear music? 🎵
explanation: Great job! Dancing is moving your body to music! 🎶
hint: You wiggle and move your feet.

question: What do you do with a fun song? 🎶
explanation: Yay! We sing songs with our voices! 🎵
hint: You make musical sounds with your mouth.

question: What do you do when you are happy? 😊
explanation: Perfect! Smiling shows everyone you are happy! ✨
hint: Your mouth turns up at the corners.

question: What do you do with a football? ⚽
explanation: Brilliant! You kick the football to score a goal! 🥅
hint: You hit it with your foot.

question: What do you do with colorful paints? 🎨
explanation: Super star! We paint pretty pictures on paper! 🖼️
hint: You use a brush to make art.

question: What do you do in a fast car? 🚗
explanation: Awesome! We drive cars to go to new places! 🛣️
hint: You hold the steering wheel.

question: What do you do on a small bicycle? 🚲
explanation: Great job! You push the pedals to ride your bike! 🌟
hint: You sit on the seat and pedal.

question: What do you do with your dirty teeth? 🦷
explanation: Yay! Brushing keeps our teeth clean and white! ✨
hint: You do this every morning and night.

question: What do you do when you hear a funny joke? 😂
explanation: Fantastic! Laughing means something is very funny! 🎈
hint: You make a happy sound from your tummy.

question: Which one is a doing word? 🏃‍♀️
explanation: Woohoo! Jump is an action where you go up in the air! ☁️
hint: You do this on a trampoline.

question: What do small babies do on the floor? 👶
explanation: Super star! Babies crawl on their hands and knees! 🥰
hint: They move close to the ground.

question: What do you do with your hands to say well done? 👏
explanation: Awesome! Clapping makes a loud, happy sound! 🎉
hint: You hit your hands together.

question: What do you do to a heavy door to open it? 🚪
explanation: Great job! You push doors to make them swing open! 🏠
hint: You use your hands to move it away from you.

question: What do you do on a soft chair? 🪑
explanation: Yay! We sit down to rest our tired legs! 🛋️
hint: You put your bottom on it.

question: What do you do when you wake up in the morning? 🥱
explanation: Perfect! Stretching feels so good when we wake up! ☀️
hint: You reach your arms high in the air.

question: What do you do with your two ears? 👂
explanation: Super star! We listen to hear our friends and teachers! 🎵
hint: It is how you hear sounds.

question: What do you do with your two eyes? 👀
explanation: Awesome! We look with our eyes to see colors and shapes! 🌈
hint: You open them to see things.

question: What do you do on a big slide? 🛝
explanation: Great job! Sliding down is super fun at the park! 🌳
hint: You sit and go fast down the ramp.

question: What do you do with a paper kite? 🪁
explanation: Yay! We fly kites high up in the windy sky! ☁️

question: What do you do with a party balloon? 🎈
explanation: Fantastic! We blow air into balloons to make them big! 🥳
hint: You put air in it with your mouth.

question: What do you do to a little flower seed? 🌱
explanation: Woohoo! We plant seeds in the dirt to grow pretty flowers! 🌻
hint: You put it in the soil.

question: Which one is an action word? 🐒
explanation: Super star! Monkeys climb up tall trees! 🌴
hint: You do this on monkey bars.

question: What do you do with a toy drum? 🥁
explanation: Awesome! We beat the drum to make loud music! 🎵
hint: You hit it with sticks.

question: What do you do with a shiny school bell? 🔔
explanation: Great job! We ring the bell to say it is time for class! 🏫

question: What do you do in a rainy puddle? ☔
explanation: Yay! Splashing in puddles with gumboots is so fun! 🌧️

question: What do you do on a soft bed at night? 🛏️
explanation: Perfect! We sleep to get ready for a new fun day! 🌙
hint: You close your eyes and dream.

question: What do you do with colorful crayons? 🖍️
explanation: Super star! We draw lovely pictures with our crayons! 🎨
hint: You make shapes on paper.

question: What do you do with a long jump rope? ➰
explanation: Awesome! We skip over the rope when we play! 👟
hint: You jump up as the rope goes under you.

question: What do you do when you catch a cold? 🤧
explanation: Great job! We sneeze when our nose tickles! 🤧

question: What do you do with tasty food in your mouth? 🥪
explanation: Yay! We chew our food so it goes down nicely! 🍽️
hint: You move your teeth up and down.

question: What do you do with a long broom? 🧹
explanation: Fantastic! We sweep the floor to make it very clean! ✨
hint: You push the dust away.

question: What do you do with bubbly soap? 🧼
explanation: Woohoo! We wash our hands to get rid of germs! 💦
hint: You scrub the dirt off.

question: What do you do with a sweet friend? 👦
explanation: Super star! We hug our friends to show we care! ❤️
hint: You put your arms around them.

question: What do you do to a toy wagon to move it? 🛻
explanation: Awesome! We pull wagons behind us to carry things! 🧸

question: Which word shows a calm action? 🚶
explanation: Great job! Walking is moving on your two feet! 👟
hint: It is slower than running.

question: What do you do when you are very sad? 😢
explanation: Yay! It is okay to cry when we feel upset. It helps us feel better! 💙

question: What do you do with a cool camera? 📷
explanation: Perfect! We click the camera to take great photos! 🖼️
hint: You push a button to take a picture.

question: What do you do with a little spoon? 🥄
explanation: Super star! We stir soup so it mixes perfectly! 🍲
hint: You move it in circles in a bowl.

question: What do you do with sharp scissors? ✂️
explanation: Awesome! We cut paper with scissors to make crafts! 🎨
hint: You snip paper into shapes.

question: What do you do to say hello from far away? 👋
explanation: Great job! Waving our hand says a big friendly hello! ✨
hint: You move your hand side to side.

question: What do you do when playing hide and seek? 🙈
explanation: Yay! We hide so our friends have to look for us! 🕵️
